definitions.explanation: A renowned, highly regarded painting recognized for its artistic value.
A film widely regarded as outstanding or a classic. Common in older or literary usage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{名画|めいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Appreciate famous paintings at an art museum.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{名画|めいが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数億円|すうおくえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This famous painting is worth several hundred million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{集|あつ}められた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧{名画|めいが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。

⟦{名画座|めいがざ}→名画座：23150_meigaza⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名画|めいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。

examples.english: He has seen almost all the films considered masterpieces.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {名|めい} (famous, renowned) and {画|が} (picture, painting). Can refer to either paintings or films depending on context. The painting sense is more common. ⟦{名画座|めいがざ}→名画座：23150_meigaza⟧ is a repertory cinema that screens classic films.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名画|めいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to appreciate a famous painting)
- {名画|めいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{所蔵|しょぞう}→所蔵：12889_shozou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to house famous paintings in a collection)
- ⟦{名画座|めいがざ}→名画座：23150_meigaza⟧ (repertory cinema)
